delivery.title: Ibisobanuro birambuye - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Pass" hano bivuze gusa ko intego ya seriveri yasubije imiterere ya HTTP 2xx - ntabwo yemeza sisitemu yo kwakira yabitswe cyangwa yatunganije icyerekezo. Reba urwego rusubiza hejuru kubyo rwavuze; niba ari ubusa cyangwa kwemerwa gusa, sisitemu irashobora kwakira icyifuzo ariko ikanga cyangwa ikirengagiza umushahara wimbere (amazina yumurima utari wo / imiterere ya API yayo, umurima usabwa kuruhande rwayo iyi mitwaro itarimo, nibindi).

push.title: Webhooks rwo hanze - Gusunika Kuyobora & Kuvugurura
push.intro: Byose birashobora guhindurwa kuri webhook : JSON , Ifishi (x-www-form-urlencoded), cyangwa icyitegererezo cyawe bwite cyumubiri hamwe na <fieldkey></fieldkey> abafite umwanya (urugero <example></example> ) - ikora nko kuzuza itegeko cURL rimwe.
push.curlHelp: Shyiramo urugero usabe inyandiko zabo API cyangwa Postman iguha (hamwe namakuru yukuri cyangwa y'icyitegererezo). URL , uburyo hamwe numutwe byandukuwe nkuko biri, kandi buri rufunguzo mumubiri ruri kurutonde hepfo kugirango uhitemo umurima CRM wuzuza kuri buri cyerekezo.
push.curlPrompt: Ufite cURL ? <action>Kuzana muri cURL</action> kugirango wuzuze ibi hamwe namakarita yumurongo byikora.
push.urlVariables: URL irashobora kuba irimo impinduka nazo, urugero <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Imitwe igomba kuba yemewe JSON , eg {{example}}
push.authTitle: Kwemeza (uko Leadrat yinjira muri API yabo)
push.modeCreateUpdate: Kora inyandiko rimwe, hanyuma uvugurure iyo nyandiko imwe (nta duplicates kuruhande rwabo)
push.responseIdHint: Aho ID iri muri JSON yabo gusubiza icyifuzo cyo gukora. Yakijijwe kuri buri cyerekezo nka <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Igihe cyateganijwe, amakosa ya HTTP 429 na 5xx - nyuma yiminota 1, min 5, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h.
push.howFilled: Uburyo indangagaciro zuzuzwa: iyi webhook yongeye gukoreshwa kuri buri cyerekezo - Leadrat ntabwo yohereza urugero ruhamye, yohereza gusunika gushya igihe cyose ibyatoranijwe bibaye, hamwe nindangagaciro ziyobora.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Ifishi ihita ishiramo buri murima uyobora - ntakintu cyo gushiraho.
push.howFilledCustom: Custom - andika icyifuzo cyawe bwite hanyuma ugabanye muri ahantu hose; buri kimwe cyahinduwe kubyo kuyobora agaciro nyako mbere yo kohereza. Kanda impinduka hepfo kugirango uyinjizemo.

receive.title: Akira - Emera kuyobora muburyo ubwo aribwo bwose
receive.intro: Buri soko ibona URL yayo. Erekana Facebook iyobora amatangazo, Zapier , urupapuro rwurubuga cyangwa urundi webhook rwa CRM kuriwo - bohereza kuyobora muri JSON yabo cyangwa imiterere yabyo, hanyuma ugashushanya imirima yabo kubwawe.

pull.title: Kurura - Fetch Iyobora muri API iyariyo yose
pull.intro: Leadrat yita indi sisitemu ya API kuri gahunda (auth iyariyo yose, page yose) kandi itumiza inyandiko igaruka. Inyandiko yabonye mbere yo kuvugurura icyerekezo kimwe.
pull.variables: Ibihinduka: <since></since> (kwiruka neza, igihe cya ISO; <others></others> bwa mbere),
pull.sampleHelp: Bika, hanyuma Fetch sample - Leadrat ihamagara API inshuro imwe (page yambere gusa) kandi ntacyo itumiza.

api.title: API yawe - Inzira ebyiri-Kubona Sisitemu Yose
api.intro: Sisitemu iyo ari yo yose ifite urufunguzo API irashobora gukora, gusoma no kuvugurura kuyobora no kwiyandikisha kuyobora ibyabaye. Ohereza urufunguzo mumutwe wa <hdr></hdr> , nka <bearer></bearer> , cyangwa (niba igikoresho kidashobora gushyiraho imitwe) nka <query></query> . Imipaka: {{limit}} ibyifuzo kumunota.
api.noPermission: Gusa umuntu ufite uruhushya rwo gucunga igenamiterere arashobora kureba urufunguzo rwa API .
api.shownOnce: Wandukure urufunguzo nonaha ubike ahantu hizewe - kubwumutekano irerekanwa rimwe gusa. Niba yazimiye, kora bundi bushya.
api.regenerateConfirm: Gukora urufunguzo rushya API ? Urufunguzo ruriho ruhagarika gukora ako kanya kuri buri sisitemu uyikoresha.
api.openApiHint: Kuzana ibicuruzwa bya OpenAPI muri Postman , Zapier , Gukora cyangwa n8n kugirango ubone amaherezo yose yiteguye gukoresha.
